knownMatters: Generated source contracts mqtt_topics.json, mcp_ugv.json and error_codes.json are absent from doc/equipment/schema; the consumer fails closed without an explicitly supplied contract directory.
Source bridge_config.yaml and the live broker publish /ugv/speed at QoS 0; consumer subscription QoS 1 cannot upgrade it or create a PUBACK.
Source bridge_config.yaml declares status/ugv1 for device ugv1, while the fixed task contract requires status/ugv.
status/ugv, /ugv/area_recon/targets and /ugv/area_recon/exception were not observed during the final 30-second source window; this is not evidence that they do not exist.
The all-seven source-backed crash/PUBACK proof is unavailable under the observed QoS0 speed stream; equivalent consumer reliability was proven on the disposable contract-shaped harness.

consumerAcceptance.evidenceScope: disposable PostgreSQL/Mosquitto/HTTP stack with contract-shaped fixtures; not source-contract authority

allowedClaim: The consumer implementation passes durable seven-stream mapping, recovery, projection and 100 msg/s-class acceptance; the five measured source deviations are retained as user-accepted known matters rather than release blockers.
